items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: we'd have to leave him a few towns -- times... all of us were concerned for his welfare... Fats would say well, if you need anything... give it to him

ctx.x: Oh, sure. Certainly. Yes. I mean you're concerned, where are you living, did you find someplace to live, is it nice? Or did you eat? Or do you feel well? And such and such a guys would get sick through the night, whatnot.

Well I'm trying to think of one case, Johnny "Buggs" Johnny Hamilton, for instance, he had ulcers, and he had this and he had the other, and quite often he got very sick and would have to leave and call the doctor, and we'd have to leave
him a few towns -- times, here, there, you know? Well, I never went through that. I was lucky, maybe, whatever you want to call it.
